choices.why: This is the most truly beige sofa of the set, with clean track arms and a simple low profile that suit a calm Japandi look against the right wall.
The jute rug is natural fiber with a warm, textured weave, and at 160x230 it is big enough to sit under both the sofa and the coffee table.
It is a low, round, all-wood table with simple legs, the most Japandi and pared-back option, and its warm tone ties in with the jute.
This tall rice paper floor lamp is exactly the lantern lamp requested and gives soft, serene light in the corner beside the sofa.
The braided money tree is the tallest, most sculptural plant, so it fills the corner by the glass balcony door well; it should go into a neutral ceramic pot.

answer.why: Beige fabric, jute, warm wood, rice paper and a single green accent create a minimal, neutral Japandi palette that warms up the dark floor and white walls without cluttering the room.
